description: , second generation of the Galactic Empire's signature vessel]] Star Destroyer was a term used to describe a certain type of medium-sized capital ship used by various factions such as the Sith Empire, the Galactic Republic, the Galactic Empire, the New Republic, the Imperial Remnant, the Galactic Federation of Free Alliances, the Alliance-in-exile, the Fel Empire, Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire and the Galactic Federation Triumvirate. It was also used to describe heavily armed warships in general.
